pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregularly shaped polygonal regions with smooth edge gradients and low contrast; spatial area is larger on the upper flank, becoming smaller and more clustered towards the shoulder and neck.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Topological network of light-colored negative space with varying thickness; exhibits distinct junction nodes where three or more pathways converge; continuity is high across the visible mid-section.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Fine-grained jagged contour along the dorsal line with consistent low-amplitude protrusions; frequency is high relative to the neck length.
